# Bid the bags, not the attic.

> Price a blown-in attic insulation job from floor areas, existing versus target R-value, bag yield, air-sealing penetrations, and baffles — not a flat price per square foot. See bag count, walk-away price, and the margin a $1.50-a-foot special actually leaves.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
